title: Eastern Municipalities Complete Universal Access Projects by End of 2020
summary: The General Authority of the Eastern Province announced the completion of universal access initiatives, ensuring infrastructure accessibility for people with disabilities and the elderly.
body:
The General Authority of the Eastern Province announced the completion of universal access initiatives, ensuring infrastructure accessibility for people with disabilities and the elderly.
